headline: Enemy Completely Destroys Main Logistics Center of NOVUS Store Chain
summary: A strike destroyed the main logistics centre of the NOVUS store chain in Ukraine. The company is redistributing product stocks to try to avoid serious supply disruptions.
why: NOVUS is a Ukrainian grocery retail chain, and its distribution network determines product availability and supply costs for stores.
